items.raw_excerpt: Formula 1 is heading back to Malaysia's Sepang International Circuit after a nine-year hiatus this weekend, with more than half the drivers on the grid unfamiliar with a track that is hosting the rescheduled Bahrain Grand Prix.
items.summary_en: Formula 1 is racing again at Sepang in Malaysia after nine years away. More than half the drivers have never driven on this track. Oscar Piastri said the surface feels like sandpaper.
items.summary_ko: 포뮬러 1이 9년 만에 말레이시아 셔랑의 인터내셔널 서킷에서 다시 열린다. 이번 그란프리를 위해 재편성된 바레인 대회에는 출전 드라이버 절반 이상이 이 서킷을 달려본 적이 없다. 오스카 피아스트리는 노면이 사포처럼 거칠다고 말했다.
items.title_en: F1 returns to Malaysia as Piastri calls track like sandpaper
items.title_ko: F1, 9년 만에 말레이시아 복귀…피아스트리는 노면을 사포에 비유
items.title_original: Piastri likens track to 'sandpaper' as F1 returns to Malaysia

items.raw_excerpt: Hyderabad Ganesh Chaturthi fuels a vast, diverse economy—from idol-making to crane ops, with public funding and record-breaking laddu auctions.
items.summary_en: The Ganesh Chaturthi festival in Hyderabad boosts the local economy. Money flows from idol making to crane rentals. Public funds support the event, and a laddu auction set a record.

items.title_en: Hyderabad's Ganesh festival makes big money
items.title_ko: 하이데라바드 가네시 축제, 신앙은 크고 돈은 더 크다
items.title_original: Hyderabad’s Ganesh puja: Big on devotion, bigger on moolah

items.raw_excerpt: Its new flagship boutique at Terminal 3's departure transit lounge also offers exclusive tea blends and a takeaway counter serving tea-infused ice cream and sorbet.
items.summary_en: TWG Tea has opened its first tea museum at Changi Airport's Terminal 3. It shows over 170 pieces of antique teaware. The shop also sells special tea blends and tea-flavored ice cream.

items.raw_excerpt: Many Australians will enjoy a long weekend this weekend, but half the country will miss out on a public holiday.
items.summary_en: Many Australians will enjoy a long weekend this weekend. But half the country will miss out on a public holiday. The day off depends on which state you live in.

items.raw_excerpt: The Journalists Association of Samoa (JAWS) is demanding answers over the removal of a journalist's camera and the deletion of photographs taken while she was covering a public event.
items.summary_en: The Journalists Association of Samoa is demanding answers after a journalist's camera was taken and her photos were deleted. The incident happened while she was covering a public event. The prime minister's security team reportedly carried out the deletion.

items.raw_excerpt: Números sorteados são: 08 - 10 - 30 - 38 - 50 - 53. Próximo concurso acontece sábado (3), às 21h.
items.summary_en: The winning numbers for Brazil's Mega-Sena lottery are 08, 10, 30, 38, 50 and 53. No one hit all six, so the jackpot grows to 82 million reais for the next draw on Saturday at 9pm.

items.raw_excerpt: Campbell had said she had no knowledge that charity funds were spent on her expenses and was deceived by another trustee about the unauthorised payments.
items.summary_en: Supermodel Naomi Campbell won an appeal against a ban on her working as a charity trustee. She said she did not know that charity funds were spent on her expenses. She said another trustee deceived her about the unauthorised payments.
items.summary_ko: 슈퍼모델 나오미 캠벨이 자선단체 수탁자 자격을 정지한 제재에 대한 항소에서 승소했다. 그녀는 자선단체 자금이 자신의 경비로 사용된 사실을 몰랐다고 밝혔다. 또 다른 수탁자에게 승인되지 않은 지급 건을 속았다고 말했다.

items.title_original: Supermodel Naomi Campbell wins appeal against charity trustee ban

items.raw_excerpt: With her Troubles-set debut Never Closer and now an adaptation of A Room with a View, Grace Chapple is establishing herself as an exciting new voice in Australian theatre.
items.summary_en: Grace Chapple is an Australian playwright. After her first play, she is now turning a classic novel into a stage work. She says the book inspired her to change her life.

items.raw_excerpt: Private Kerala buses struggle amid dwindling revenues and a popular free-travel scheme, sparking fierce stand congestion and risked livelihoods.
items.summary_en: Private buses in Kerala, India are losing money as passenger income falls. A popular free-travel scheme has made things harder, and drivers now worry about their jobs.
items.summary_ko: 인도 케랄라의 사설 버스는 탑승 수입이 줄어들어 어려움을 겪고 있다. 인기 있는 무료 승차 정책이 상황을 더 악화시켜 운전자들이 생계를 걱정하고 있다.
items.title_en: Private Bus Sector in Kerala Faces a Crisis

items.raw_excerpt: Las estaciones comprendidas entre Melipilla, Talagante y Cerrillos mantendrán sus fechas de apertura proyectadas hacia 2028 y 2029. El enlace de tres kilómetros que conectará con Estación Central sufrirá un retraso producto de una relicitación.
items.summary_en: Chile's government confirmed the Melitren commuter rail will open stations between Melipilla, Talagante, and Cerrillos in 2028 and 2029. The three-kilometer link to Estación Central is delayed until 2033 because of a new bidding process.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 정부는 멜리트렌 광역철도의 멜리피야·탈라간테·세리요스 역을 2028년과 2029년에 개통한다고 확인했다. 새 입찰 절차 탓에 에스타시온 센트랄까지 잇는 3km 구간은 2033년으로 미뤄졌다.
items.title_en: Melitren rail opens first stations by 2029, final link delayed to 2033

items.title_original: Melitren: Gobierno ratificó operación inicial a Lo Errázuriz, pero aplazó tramo final hasta 2033

items.raw_excerpt: A town is a highly sensitive ecosystem of shops, bars, cafes, restaurants, residents, local leaders, workers, professionals, schools, churches, sports clubs – something we call community
items.summary_en: A small town is more than buildings. It is a web of shops, schools, clubs, and people who form a close community. Simple ideas can help keep these rural towns alive.

items.raw_excerpt: Prawn allergy can mean more than simply skipping the crustacean on your plate, especially when shellfish is common in Singapore cooking. Could gradually exposing the body to prawn offer another way to manage the allergy?
items.summary_en: A prawn allergy can be hard to live with, because shellfish is common in Singapore cooking. Doctors want to know if giving tiny amounts of prawn to the body can help manage it. A first trial in Singapore is now studying this method.
items.summary_ko: 새우 알레르기가 있으면 갑각류가 흔히 쓰이는 싱가포르 음식을 피해 가기가 어렵다. 새우를 조금씩 몸에 노출하면 알레르기를 관리하는 방법이 될지 궁금하다. 싱가포르에서 처음 열린 이 시험은 그 가능성을 연구하고 있다.
items.title_en: Allergic to prawns? A Singapore trial studies how to build tolerance

items.summary_en: Tigst Assefa ran the last two kilometers of the Berlin Marathon with a badly torn Achilles tendon. She needed surgery right away. Even so, she set the third-fastest women's marathon time in history.

items.raw_excerpt: A shop owner in a Northland town cut off by a slip for more than eight months says the road closure has been "hell on wheels" - so today's re-opening is a huge relief.
items.summary_en: A shop owner in a Northland town was cut off by a slip for more than eight months. The road closure was hell on wheels for local businesses. Now the road has re-opened and the shop owner feels huge relief.

items.summary_en: The Hurricanes, a New Zealand rugby team, signed two new players this week. Both will join the squad for the 2027 season. The team hopes the signings will make them stronger.

items.summary_en: Taiwan's military held a full-scale National Day flyover rehearsal over Taipei on Friday. Five Brave Eagle jet trainers closed the show with red, blue and white smoke over the Presidential Office.
